# TEST FIXTURE: a made-up research note for CLIVE's research tests

This file is written for the tests in tests/test_research.py. It is not George's research and it
is never shown on his screen as if it were. Every recommendation in it exists to exercise one path.

## Connections

Each card on the Connections screen should show when its key was last checked, as a short line
such as "checked 4 minutes ago", so a stale key is obvious at a glance.

## Messaging

CLIVE should add WhatsApp as a channel so suppliers can message it directly about orders.

## Speed

Use the Anthropic API with a pay-as-you-go key for faster answers during busy periods.

Refunds under ten pounds should be applied automatically without his approval to save time.

## Background

Most small brands answer customer emails within a day.
